claude_proposed_widenings.name: dual_mode_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring has two mutually exclusive activation modes chosen at use time (attack OR object-break). The current activation family models phases as a sequential list joined by branches_on_completion. No construct exists for 'choose one of N alternative phase sequences per activation.' Adding both as phases implies they execute sequentially, which is false.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 to 3 charges to make a ranged spell attack... Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as a Magic action to try to break a nonmagical object...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.per_charge_spent
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Damage is 2d10 Force per charge spent (1→2d10, 2→4d10, 3→6d10). resource_spent captures charge-variable amounts but carries no dice-per-charge formula. A new variant is needed: { kind: 'per_charge_spent', perCharge: DiceExpr }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: for each charge you spend, the target takes 2d10 Force damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: force_move per-charge distance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Push distance is 5 ft per charge spent (1→5 ft, 2→10 ft, 3→15 ft). The force_move atom has a fixed distanceFeet field with no scaling hook. A per-charge variant or a distanceFeetPerCharge field is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: for each charge you spend, the target takes 2d10 Force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.ability_check_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The object-breaking mode triggers a Strength check (not an attack roll, not a saving throw). The v4 taxonomy includes ability_check as a resolution atom, but the surface ActivationPhase union only covers attack_roll, save_gate, and direct. The ability_check phase variant is absent from the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend

claude_proposed_widenings.name: break_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-success outcome of the Strength check is breaking a nonmagical object. No v4 effect atom covers physical object destruction. The nearest atoms (damage, force_move, block_travel) target creatures or spaces. A break_object atom targeting objects is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as a Magic action to try to break a nonmagical object you can see within 60 feet of yourself
